full_text: Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL OPINION NO. 01 June 2010 VICE MAYOR ELENA SIA BALETE Bobon, Northern Samar Dear Vice Mayor Balete: 75 s. 2010 This is in response to your letter seeking our opinion on matters concerning the hiring of a private lawyer for the recovery of ownership and possession of a parcel of public land. In reply thereto, please be informed that we already answered a similar query in Opinion No. 26, s. 2004, dated 03 February 2004, a photocopy of which is attached hereto for your ready reference. In said opinion, we opined that it is the duty of the legal officer to represent a local government unit in all its civil actions and special proceedings wherein the local government unit or any official thereof, in his official capacity, is a party. However, in the case of Mancenido E. Court Qt Appeals (330 SCRA 419), the Supreme Court enumerated three (3) instances as to when the representation of a local government unit by a private attorney is allowed. Finding no convincing reason to change our views in our previous Opinion mentioned above, we are of the stance that the same substantially apply to the issues you raised in your letter. We hope we have enlightened you on the matter. Very truly yours, By Authority of the Secretary: nv. JES Director III Encl.: LS2 B. DO UE IV
